key_insight: As decaying turbulence weakens, the Hinze scale can outgrow bubble sizes, reorganizing the bubble population from breakup-influenced to coalescence-dominated dynamics.
engineering_relevance: This provides scaling laws for predicting bubble size, interfacial area, and coalescence in bubbly flows relevant to reactors, ducts, and multiphase turbulence models.
method: Theory for bubble-interaction and scaling laws in decaying homogeneous isotropic turbulence
Direct numerical simulation of dilute bubbly turbulence
Experiments in a spatially developing pump-driven bubbly duct flow
evidence_signal: Theory, DNS, and experiments all show power-law decay of turbulent energy/dissipation and consistent transitions in bubble-size distributions and growth regimes.
watch_item: The duct-flow validation is promising but still affected by confinement, inhomogeneity, and wall-driven production, so the idealized scalings may need calibration before deployment.
paper_title: On the scaling of bubble interactions in dynamic turbulence: theoretical, numerical, and experimental study
